name: Walker Tienkung
summary: UBTECH Walker Tienkung (product model TK2101): the base model of UBTECH's Walker Tienkung series. Per UBTECH's user manual: 1730 ± 10 mm, 64 kg net, 20 integrated joints (arms 4 × 2, legs 6 × 2), no cameras or voice module and no development compute unit listed (only the Intel i7-1355U motion-control unit), dual battery with more than 3.5 h endurance. Intended by UBTECH for scientific research and education. A separate model from Walker Tienkung · Voice & Vision (TK2201) and Walker Tienkung · Embodied Intelligence (TK2301).
specs_note: Specifications are those stated in UBTECH's own Walker Tienkung user manual, '5.
